name: onelake-studio
description: Browse and query Microsoft Fabric OneLake Iceberg tables with DuckDB, signed in with your VS Code Microsoft account.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Browse and query OneLake Iceberg tables with DuckDB, signed in with the Microsoft account VS Code already holds — you register nothing.
[Sign in to OneLake](command:onelakeStudio.signIn)

onelakeStudio.tenantId.markdownDescription: Directory (tenant) GUID to sign in against. Leave empty for your home tenant; set it to reach a tenant you are a guest in.

onelakeStudio.dataCacheGB.markdownDescription: Disk to spend caching OneLake data, in GB. Iceberg data files and manifests are kept until evicted — a new snapshot writes new files, so a cached one can never be stale. Reading a table you have opened before comes off disk instead of the network. Set to `0` to cache nothing; `OneLake Studio: Clear Cached OneLake Data` empties it and reports what it freed.

onelakeStudio.catalogTtlMinutes.markdownDescription: How long catalog answers, listings and other mutable objects are served from disk before OneLake is asked again. Within this window a table opens from the last-known answer, no network check — a snapshot written moments ago shows up once the window lapses. Raise it if your tables change rarely and the catalog's seconds-per-call annoy you more than a stale-by-minutes view. `0` asks OneLake every time.
